accepted.title: Propagate controlled-memory ceilings (max_controlled_bytes) and budget-error qualification across MP4 and Matroska audio loudness, loudnorm, mix, merge, sample-domain concat, spatial AAC routing, and Matroska PCM metadata extraction
accepted.summary: Clamps MP4 Limits::metadata_bytes and Matroska Limits::packets to options.max_controlled_bytes across owned_aac_export_routing::router_for_decode, owned_audio_plan::matroska_descriptor_for_decode, extract_source_pcm_metadata_with_interval_packet_and_memory_limit, validate_and_inspect_source_with_options, segment_packet_count, validate_concat_segments_with_options, and native_loudnorm::try_plan/try_apply, and prefixes clamped MP4 metadata budget errors with 'controlled memory budget exceeded: ' so owned loudness, loudnorm, audio export, and plan qualification preserve budget refusals instead of returning false.
